Request: at round 14 Lin (energy 38.8, standing about 1.1 m from the mature berry plant commons-berry-0-0, owning only the berry stack item-6-lin-57) asked for a practical way to tend or propagate an existing berry plant for a dependable local food supply, with learning that takes world time and physical effects that need real work and suitable conditions. World Agent decision: develop (learning 3) a general water_plant(target, waterItem, carrier, quantityLitres) operation with real collection and carrying of water, a conserved soil-water input bound to the existing soil moisture and growth code, refusal when measured conditions do not justify watering, no growth claim and no reward. Narrowed scope decided by the user: the water source is a small amount of visible river or shallow water within hand reach, taken by hand or with a water vessel that already exists (no vessel making and no new container); real energy costs to collect and to pour; spillage of hand-held water while carrying and in the pour; the target is only the soil plot of an existing rooted plant object (no bare ground or general terrain watering); the effect exists only where the package is installed; and the study cost, refusal before any cost when the measured moisture already meets the plant requirement or the soil is waterlogged, no growth claim and no reward are kept. Implemented (full mechanism): rooted-plant-watering@1 (ability rooted-plant-watering, handler long.rooted-plant-watering, equivalence plant:root-zone-water-dose:1, learning 3 with no study energy, 2,279 code units, appended last to the package list) with modes collect, water and status, each one round. collect (x, y of a personally visible ~ or = cell whose edge is within 0.65 m of a person standing on the bank with a clear reach, reusing waterSurface of the ex10 river-contact-water@1 helpers) costs 0.3 energy and fills two cupped hands to 0.2 L, or an owned item with an existing water vessel record to its capacity; a represented finite river compartment, if one exists, is debited, otherwise the withdrawal is recorded per source in the person's hand record. Hand water is a per-person state record, not an inventory item: at each round end, the collection round included, 40% of what is left leaks and 20% more per metre walked (compounded), and below 0.005 L it is gone; it is lost at death. water (target: a growing plant object rooted in the ground and within reach; quantityLitres optional, default all held, at most 0.5 L) costs 2 energy per litre poured (at least 0.05); 20% of a hand pour (5% from a vessel) misses the root zone and the rest is delivered to the root zone of the plant's 1 m x 1 m terrain cell, shared by every plant rooted in it, where water above saturation runs off. It is refused before any cost, with the measured values, when soil moisture already meets the plant requirement (for Lin's berry plant 0.65 against 0.6, so its growth water factor is already 1), when the plot is waterlogged (hazard waterlogging above 0.1 or moisture at least 1.3), when the target is not a rooted growing plant (reeds, items, water cells, bare ground), when it is out of reach, or when no water is held. status (no energy) reports the held water, the plot moisture, requirement, waterlogging and the root-zone record. A new module stores retained root-zone litres per watered cell with documented parameters: 30 L raise the 0-1.5 moisture index of the top 0.15 m of one square metre by 1, field capacity at index 1 (half the water above it drains below the root zone each round), saturation at 1.3 (the excess runs off), and evaporation of 10% of the retained water per round, at most 0.0375 L (3 L per square metre per 80-round day), with a last trace below 1 mL evaporating; each cell keeps a closed ledger (received = retained + runoff + drained + evaporated) and each hand record another (collected = held + poured + carry spill, poured = delivered + pour spill), both asserted. One gated hook in openConditions adds the retained water to the ground-derived moisture only when a cell record with retained litres exists and rooted-plant-watering@1 is installed, so the existing plant update (openPlants and forestGrowth, unchanged) reads it through its own min(1, moisture / requirement) rule and waterlogging penalty; without that revision or without delivered water openConditions returns exactly what it returned before (tested, including a stray record in a world without the revision, which replays identically). Events plant-watering-collected, -poured, -spilled, -plot-dry and -status carry view metadata (operation, actor, phase, target, cell, carrier, litres, progress) with visualComponents empty; the practice evidence is plant-watering-poured, which never carries a qualified flag, so there is no practice milestone, satisfaction source or reward. Assumptions: (1) the root zone is the terrain cell under the plant, so a dose is shared by all plants rooted in that cell and also raises the soil moisture read anywhere in that cell; (2) the cell's ground-derived moisture for retention, runoff and drainage is measured at the cell centre; (3) the added water is the first to evaporate and to drain, and the ground-derived base is left unchanged; (4) hands leak by the stated fractions whatever else the person does, and other actions do not empty them at once; (5) the ex23 river is not represented as finite, so a hand scoop does not deplete it; (6) a vessel's own leakage belongs to its own package and is not modelled here; (7) watering a plot whose moisture is already above the requirement is refused rather than allowed as a no-op. A throwaway check on the archived round-14 world installed the package, had Lin learn it in three rounds and refused water on commons-berry-0-0 before any cost with soil moisture 0.65, waterlogging 0 and requirement 0.6; it was deleted afterwards. What Lin can do now: after three study rounds, scoop water by hand at a river bank, carry it with real leakage and pour it on a rooted plant whose measured soil is drier than it needs, and read the plot with status; one hand scoop carried 0.8 m in one round delivers about 0.048 L, which raises the cell's moisture by about 0.0016 and evaporates within about 40 rounds. Her own berry plant is correctly refused because it is not water-limited, and in this world every plant whose measured soil is below its requirement (now the plum on rocky ground, fern-root and fungus plots; during the drought also the western berry, root, hazelnut and acorn plants) stands at least 12.7 m from river or shallow water, so no hand-carried water survives the walk: today the operation can be used only on such plots within a few metres of water, for example newly established plants there or plots in a drought that reaches the river. First release: no; the narrowed scope is implemented as a simplified but real mechanism with real costs, spillage, a conserved and decaying soil-water store read by the existing growth code, and refusals with measured values, so the fallback was not needed.

Implemented (full mechanism, not a first release): crack-and-separate-casing@1 (ability crack-and-separate-casing, handler long.crack-and-separate-casing, equivalence material:hard-casing:supported-impact-block-crack-separate:1, learning 3 with no study energy, 3,357 code units, appended last to the package list) with modes crack, separate and crack-and-separate, plus resume, pause and cancel (one round, no energy) and quoteOnly, which reports quantity, blocks, striker condition (mass, recorded contacts, soundness), the exact phase count, maximum energy and wear bounds at no cost and reserves nothing. A start validates everything before any charge: a living worker; target an own unreserved, untreated, unspoiled item of a material with a represented casing (closed for the crack modes, cracked unseparated for separate); quantity in exact tenths from 0.1 to 1 (default all, up to 1) and not above the item; for the crack modes a striker that is an own whole, rigid (hardness at least 1), sound inedible piece and a support that is a solid, unreserved, inedible, rigid object within reach and in view, not a plant or animal, or another own sound piece on firm ground, all three different; and energy for the first phase. The selected quantity is reserved in one work record (workId) with the striker and support pinned; ownership, reach, soundness, energy and the reserved material are rechecked before every phase, and a failed recheck refuses an explicit resume at no cost or pauses a continuing round before any charge. Cracking: each round takes one 0.1 block and applies one bounded impact whose load is the lower of striker and support strength x (1 - flexibility) (hidden, never reported); at or below the casing strength (hardness / 10, 0.4 for hazelnut) the casing is unchanged, a real paid result that ends the job and returns the material as it was (identical further impacts with the pinned gear could not change it; a reattempt is new paid work); above it the block gains damage (load - strength) / strength from its current state: below 1 it stays closed and damaged in a reserved closed item carrying its damage, at 1 it fractures open into reserved cracked unseparated material. Separation: one hand round per opened block (no striker, support, reach of the rock or light needed) takes it apart into exactly 0.1 loose kernel and 0.1 casing fragments; in crack-and-separate a block that does not open incurs no separation phase. Products are exact tenths of three part materials whose unit is that part of one whole source unit, derived from the hazelnut row and the composition: hazelnut-loose-kernel (0.08 kg per unit, all of the unit's nutrition 18 and toxicity 0, the same decay lifetime, a food record of unprocessed hazelnut), hazelnut-casing-fragments (0.12 kg, no food value, no decay) and hazelnut-cracked-mixed (the whole opened unit, unseparated); each block therefore partitions exactly, and a finer internal ledger in tenths and kg records input, untouched, closed, mixed, kernel, fragments, casing debris (always 0: fragments are counted whole) and striker and support wear, and must balance. Products are owned, separately addressable, merged per job, and carry the source origin, the earliest harvest and the oldest decay of their parts plus a record of the job, the parent item, the part and certified false; nothing is washed, heated, made safe or eaten. Wear (deterministic, scratchStroke rules): a striker no harder than the casing sheds one 0.0001 kg quantum per impact; after a fracture the striker following through onto the support sheds one if it is no harder than the support, while a support softer by 0.5 than the casing or the striker is marked by one; the quantum is debited from the item's physical solids and recorded on the item (stone on the equally hard rock loses 0.0001 kg per fracture, 0.0009 kg for Kai's nine blocks); an object support's mass is not represented, so its marks are ledger-only; the striker never fractures because the passed load never exceeds its own strength; no tool life is invented. Lifecycle: a round without a paid phase pauses the work between phases at no charge; the same action or resume continues it after rechecks and emits a resumed event; cancel releases surviving reserved material once to the owner as it now is and keeps products, fractures, spent energy and wear; death ends the work and leaves reserved material at the worksite while products follow the ordinary death rules; reserved material that spoils ends the work and returns the rest; nothing runs autonomously and paused material keeps ageing. Events (view metadata only, no visual components): casing-cracking-quoted, -started, -impact, -unchanged, -damaged, -fractured, -tool-wear, -separated, -products, -completed, -paused, -resumed, -cancelled and -failed, each with operation, plan and phase, actor, target, striker and support references, position, progress and product items and quantities, and for phases the affected 0.1, prior and resulting casing state, crack value and an evidence id; a closed block never shows contents, no event shows a pose unless a phase was performed, and no badge, nutrition or safety icon appears. Personal records use openRemember keyed by material, striker and support materials and outcome, so the first fracture and first separation are new verified information and identical repeats are not; those information events carry this interface, not probe, and the completion event has no qualified flag, so no satisfaction, practice milestone or reward results. Base rules on products: eat, give and drop take whole units (integer quantity of at least 1), so Kai's 0.9 kernel and 0.9 fragment items can be neither eaten, handed over nor dropped; a whole unit of loose kernel, were one held, is eaten under the existing food rules with exactly one hazelnut unit's nutrition. Assumptions: owned items are carried, so the target and striker are at the worker and the 0.65 m reach applies to the support; the engine quantum of 0.1 unit is the block; the hazelnut kernel is wholly accessible once its casing fractures (ex20 composition), so for hazelnut the only damaged mixed material is opened blocks not yet separated; the kernel keeps the hazelnut row's other properties as in ex20; merged lots keep the oldest decay; the operation needs no light, and in the dark the kernel's condition is reported as not seen; one mass quantum per abrasive contact; travel, acquiring a striker and study are separate existing actions. Kai can now study it (3 rounds), walk to start-1-stone, gather one stone with the existing gather action, quote the job, and crack and separate item-16-kai-161 on the rock in 18 rounds for 13.5 energy into 0.9 loose kernel and 0.9 casing fragments; a throwaway check on the archived round-18 world did exactly that (study, navigate, gather, quote, 18 rounds with energy falling by exactly 13.5, stone mass 1.9991 kg, job completed) and was then deleted. a unit whose parent is not a living plant of its food yields no seed, a paid informative failure leaving all 0.2 kg in a pulp item. inspect (1 round, 0.2 energy, changes nothing in the world) reports for x, y in reach the ground, moisture, waterlogging, drought, temperature, light, season, nearest object, plants of the food within 5 m, whether and why the site can be sown and the sowing rule, and for a target its visible state: a source berry's freshness and whether a whole unit can be opened (seeds not visible), a seed lot's lineage with viability unknown, or a patch's visible stage. sow (target an own seed lot, x, y in reach) refuses before any cost on water, the wet bank, rocky ground, waterlogged soil, forest floor and other ground the existing hand-preparation rule excludes, outside the 0.3-1.2 moisture band, within 0.6 m of an object or person, or where 3 plants of the food or patches being sown stand within 5 m; round one (1 energy) loosens a 0.1 m radius patch 0.03 m deep in place (942 cm3) inside a 0.25 m reserved plant footprint while the reserved seeds stay carried; round two (1 energy) removes the seeds from the inventory into the patch record with their mass and lineage, covers them 5 mm deep and makes the patch an ecology propagule with stock 0, capacity 4 and the parent's interval 5. The patch then roots only when the unchanged ecology's establishment reaches 12 (a twin natural seedling at the same point gains exactly the same establishment each round in the test); it becomes a plant named Red berries with no fruit, and its first fruit comes only from the existing growth rule and is gathered by anyone. Each sown patch persists rounds, eligible and stalled rounds, establishment, moisture exposure, cold, dark and waterlogged rounds, failures and lineage. pause, resume and cancel cost nothing; rechecks of seeds, patch, reach, site and energy refuse an explicit start or resume at no cost and pause a continuing round before any charge, as does a round without work; cancel returns unsown seeds once and leaves the loosened patch, which a later sowing at that point reuses for one round; death ends the work, leaves unsown seeds where the person died and does not touch loosened or sown patches; nothing advances unless the world steps. Events seed-propagation-extracted, -no-seed, -inspected, -prepared, -sown, -paused, -resumed, -cancelled, -failed, -established and -first-fruit carry view metadata (work id, source lineage, site position, phase, completed and required labor, visible material, plant stage from unverified seed, patch being prepared, prepared patch, sown patch and emerged seedling to established plant, and evidence id); a failed extraction shows no seed product, a sown patch is drawn as a mound and never as a rooted plant, unfinished work is drawn dashed, and transitions update no personal record. Owner rules: only the owner controls a work or names their seeds; reserved seeds cannot be given; a given seed lot is sown by its new owner with its lineage; anyone may inspect a patch and gather fruit. No reward: the review's proposed bounded experience credit was not implemented because this handoff excludes rewards; records are deduplicated by parent plant and outcome or by site, item or patch, their events carry this interface, which no satisfaction source listens to, and the sowing event carries no qualified flag. Assumptions: (1) seeds are 5 % of a berry unit's fresh mass, a declared value of the order of small-seeded bramble and currant fruits; (2) the seeds of one unit are the one propagule the dispersal law draws from one stock unit, so one lot sows one patch and starts at most one plant, never more than the ecology itself would from the same fruit; (3) seeds are present when the unit's parent is a living plant of its food, the ex16 to ex18 propagule rule, and the zero-seed pulp keeps the whole mass with the 0.85 berry water share; (4) every represented lot is viable under the model but reported unknown until something emerges, and with no seed mortality, dormancy or longevity in the world a sown lot stalls under cold, darkness, drought or waterlogging but does not die; (5) germination is the existing establishment accumulation reaching 12, with no separate delay, and the 0.6 moisture scale is that growth law's, not a measured germination requirement; (6) the 0.1 m loosened circle, the 0.03 m loosening and 5 mm cover depths are declared and recorded, but the establishment law has no depth term, so depth changes neither rate nor outcome; (7) the site rule is the ex15 to ex18 predicate, so forest floor is refused as there; (8) the patch is a seed-sowing-patch object without an owner until it roots, then a plant, so watering applies only once rooted; (9) a paused work is continued with resume or a sowing request at the same site, because the kernel refuses naming reserved seeds at no cost.
